## Checklist (all boxes are required)

- [ ] **Data only:** I changed files in `/data` only (no workflows, scripts, images, or community files).
- [ ] **No secrets:** no API keys, tokens, passwords, keystores, or server credentials.
- [ ] **No private info:** no emails, phone numbers, real names of private people, or tester details.
- [ ] **Valid JSON:** the "Validate JSON data" check passes.
- [ ] **My own work:** I wrote this or have the right to share it; nothing copyrighted that I do not own.
- [ ] **Classy:** no slurs, cursing, harassment, or content about real private people.
- [ ] **License:** I agree my contribution is offered under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and that I grant the owner the license described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/binkybell225/BluEmpress/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
